correctness.rationale: The fair-input transform has exact length recurrence a_(2n+rho)=a_n+E[a_B]+rho, B~Bin(n,1/2), with a_0=0,a_1=1 and b_m=a_m/2 for residual-one expectation. The golden exponent alpha=log_2 phi obeys n^alpha+(n/2)^alpha=(2n)^alpha. Taylor concavity and Chernoff bound control the binomial Jensen deficit uniformly by <4, including the B=0 atom. The constants 1/10,9/10 in the positive-length lower induction have spare >=.05; the 3,-2 upper induction includes odd lengths and B=0 correctly. Thus all N>=1 bounds and existential worst-case lower follow. Independent rational recurrence through N=64 and all 2^N strings through N=10 agreed; those finite checks are not the infinite proof.
residual_risks: Expected residual length has no proved limit prefactor a_N/N^alpha here; biased inputs and maximum upper exponent are excluded.
